title: Figure 3. Circular Resonator Geometry Using IR Excitation; Fig. 4 Radiation Pattern
description: Figure 3 shows a blue circular ring labeled "IR monomode waveguide formed by active material" with "Mirrors" fed by a "High power IR source" box and a central red-circled point marked "Position of focused GW generated". Figure 4, "Radiation Pattern Calculated by Landau and Lifshitz (1975)", shows an elliptical orbit with masses A and B, force vectors fcf and Δfcf, and a gray two-lobed 3D radiation pattern along the GW axis.
